app.title: Log Classification Pipeline
noscript.message: This local interface requires JavaScript for protected form submissions. The HTTP API remains available to authenticated clients.
login.title: Sign in
login.help: Use the organization and account created from the local CLI.
login.rate_limited: Too many failed login attempts. Wait briefly and try again.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.heading: Classification workspace
dashboard.help: Upload bounded synthetic or already-sanitized log files. Raw source storage is disabled on the web surface.
classify.heading: Classify a file
classify.formats: JSONL, NDJSON, TXT, LOG or CSV · up to {max_mib} MiB and {max_records} records
classify.model_help: The rules baseline is selected first and loads no model artifact. Every zero-shot profile is experimental and may abstain.
model.rules.label: Rules baseline — safe default
model.rules.description: Fast deterministic wiring check using English keywords; it is not an ML quality model.
model.english-deberta-v1.label: DeBERTa — English
model.english-deberta-v1.description: Experimental English zero-shot profile; external model files are required.
model.multilingual-minilm-v1.label: MiniLM — multilingual, fast CPU
model.multilingual-minilm-v1.description: Lightest multilingual experiment; measured quality is not sufficient for a default.
model.multilingual-mdeberta-v1.label: mDeBERTa — multilingual, asynchronous
model.multilingual-mdeberta-v1.descripti: Heavier multilingual experiment intended for queued work, not interactive CPU use.
model.multilingual-bge-m3-v1.label: BGE-M3 — multilingual, GPU preferred
model.multilingual-bge-m3-v1.description: Largest experimental profile; unsuitable for synchronous CPU use on the measured host.
model.custom.description: Custom configured predictor; verify its provenance, languages, and operating limits locally.

audit.heading: Recent audit events
job.heading: Job {id}
job.progress_help: Progress is staged and is not published as a result until the complete job succeeds.
job.waiting: This page updates while the local worker processes the job.
job.failed: The job ended without publishing classification results.
failure.input_invalidated: The staged input no longer passed validation.
failure.interrupted: The local worker was interrupted or restarted.
error.input_too_large: The input exceeds the configured limits.
error.model_busy: The local queue is full or unavailable. Try again later.
js.csrf_missing: The session protection token is missing. Reload the page.
js.unreachable: The local service could not be reached. No success was assumed.
